questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a base quantity in the International System of Units (SI)?
questions.explanation: The seven SI base quantities are: length (m), mass (kg), time (s), electric current (A), thermodynamic temperature (K), amount of substance (mol), and luminous intensity (cd). Force is a derived quantity (newton, N = kgÂ·mÂ·sâ»Â²), not a base quantity.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In an experiment, the length of a rod is measured as 25.4 cm using a vernier caliper with least count 0.01 cm. The measurement should be recorded as:
questions.explanation: The least count is 0.01 cm (two decimal places). The measurement must reflect the precision of the instrument. 25.4 cm implies precision of 0.1 cm, while 25.40 cm correctly indicates precision to 0.01 cm. Significant figures must match instrument precision.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Image-based Question: The figure shows the reading of a screw gauge. The pitch of the screw is 0.5 mm and there are 50 divisions on the circular scale. What is the diameter of the wire?
questions.explanation: Least count = Pitch/Number of divisions = 0.5 mm/50 = 0.01 mm. Main scale reading = 2.5 mm (visible as 2 mm + 0.5 mm half mark). Circular scale reading = 32 divisions. Total reading = 2.5 mm + (32 Ã— 0.01 mm) = 2.5 + 0.32 = 2.82 mm.

questions.question: If force (F), velocity (V), and time (T) are chosen as fundamental quantities, the dimensional formula of mass would be:

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a system where the units of length, mass, and time are doubled, the unit of energy will become:
questions.explanation: Energy has dimensions [MLÂ²Tâ»Â²]. When each base unit is doubled: new energy unit = (2M)(2L)Â²/(2T)Â² = 2 Ã— 4 / 4 = 2 times the original energy unit. So 1 new energy unit = 2 old energy units. The numerical value of a given physical energy expressed in the new system is therefore HALF of what it was. The unit itself becomes double (2 times) the old unit.

questions.explanation: Effective length l = L + r = 100.0 + 2.0 = 102.0 cm. But if L is already to centre of bob, l = 1.00 m. With ruler precision Â±0.1 cm in 100 cm, Î”l/l = 0.001 Ã— 2 = 0.2% (factor 2 since g âˆ l). Î”g = 9.87 Ã— 0.004 â‰ˆ 0.04. So g = 9.87 Â± 0.04 m/sÂ².
